name: dorar-hadith-mcp
description: Search and research Hadith through Dorar.net directly in Claude Desktop, including scholarly grading, authenticity, Takhrīj (source references), and related Hadith information, with results in Arabic and English. For best results, include “using the Dorar tool” when asking Claude to search Dorar.

tools.name: search_hadith_api
tools.description: Search for hadiths using the Dorar.net API endpoint. This provides comprehensive hadith search with various filters.

tools.name: search_hadith_site
tools.description: Search for hadiths using the site data endpoint. Similar to API search but using different data source.

tools.name: get_hadith_by_id
tools.description: Get a specific hadith by its ID.

tools.name: get_similar_hadiths
tools.description: Get similar hadiths for a given hadith ID.

tools.name: get_alternate_hadith
tools.description: Get alternate sahih hadith for a given hadith ID.

tools.name: get_usul_hadith
tools.description: Get the original/root hadith for a given hadith ID.

tools.name: get_hadith_sources
tools.description: Get the original/root sources (usul) for a given hadith ID. Same data as get_usul_hadith, provided under a sources-focused name.

tools.name: get_hadith_grading
tools.description: Get a focused grading summary (hadith text, grade, explainGrade, hadithId) for a given hadith ID, with gradeEnglish resolved via the grading glossary (exact match only, never guessed).

tools.name: get_hadith_commentary
tools.description: Get the sharh (commentary/explanation) for a given hadith ID by resolving its sharhMetadata and fetching the full commentary.

tools.name: get_hadith_grading_consensus
tools.description: Search for a hadith phrase and return each matching result from dorar.net faithfully, in dorar's own order, with gradeEnglish resolved per entry. Queries the specialist tab first, falling back to non-specialist only if specialist is empty (resultSource states which). Performs no grouping or consensus computation.

tools.name: search_sharh
tools.description: Search for sharh (explanations) of hadiths.

tools.name: get_sharh_by_id
tools.description: Get sharh (explanation) for a hadith by ID.

tools.name: get_sharh_by_text
tools.description: Get sharh (explanation) for a hadith by searching for specific text.

tools.name: get_mohdith_info
tools.description: Get information about a muhadith (hadith narrator) by ID.

tools.name: get_book_info
tools.description: Get information about a hadith book by ID.

tools.name: get_books_data
tools.description: Get list of all available hadith books with their IDs and names.

tools.name: get_degrees_data
tools.description: Get list of all hadith degrees (authenticity levels) with their IDs and names.

tools.name: get_method_search_data
tools.description: Get method search data for hadith filtering.

tools.name: get_mohdith_data
tools.description: Get list of all muhaddithun (hadith narrators) with their IDs and names.

tools.name: get_rawi_data
tools.description: Get list of all rawi (hadith transmitters) with their IDs and names.

tools.name: get_zone_search_data
tools.description: Get zone search data for geographic hadith filtering.
